## Breaking change?

- [ ] **No** — existing consumers keep working without changes.
- [ ] **Yes** — and the PR title carries a `!` (e.g. `feat(dotnet)!: …`) or the description has a `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer. Includes dropping a target framework / Python version, renaming or removing public API, changing defaults.

<!-- The release helper reads commit types and the `BREAKING CHANGE:` footer to suggest a version bump. It is advisory only — a `chore:` or unmarked breaking change ships as if it were safe unless a human overrides the version. -->
